established: a working from-scratch pretraining and SFT pipeline exists and has produced loadable checkpoints
the pipeline is licence-gated: only sources in licence_verification.json verified_ids enter training
the CPU-only host can train a ~2.85M-parameter model, and a ~9.36M-parameter configuration was preflight-measured at ~207 MiB peak RSS
the corpus comprises only licence-verified Python library source
not_demonstrated: any useful coding capability (see the M6 capability report)
functional correctness on any benchmark example
instruction following above chance on the M5 benchmark
that the corpus can teach any task beyond next-token prediction
that a larger model would help, absent data for those tasks

holdout.reason: The test split is withheld from M3 on purpose. Its licence composition is unresolved (psf-black), and tuning against it would spend the only data reserved for final measurement.

task_coverage.basis: the corpus is Python library source, so completion-style supervision exists implicitly through next-token prediction
no instruction->code pairs; the corpus is raw source, not prompts
no failing-code/patch pairs anywhere in the corpus
tests appear as source text, never as instruction->test pairs
docstrings exist inside files but no docstring-generation supervision
the verified corpus contains no SQL
no CI, Docker or infra configuration
absent by construction; M4 attempted to synthesise it from code and produced an instruction/completion mismatch

data.disablement_note: The verified corpus is Python library source only. It supports next-token prediction, which is why M3 reached a low loss, but it contains no supervision for debugging, refactoring, test generation, explanation, documentation, SQL or architecture. A low loss on this corpus cannot become coding capability on those tasks without new data.

scales.name: Existing 2.85M research baseline
scales.note: reproducibility baseline; already trained, keep unchanged

scales.name: Modest 30M proposal
scales.note: smallest scale that could plausibly generalise across tasks

scales.name: 125M proposal
scales.note: GPT-2-small class; requires compute this host does not have

scales.name: 350M proposal
scales.note: only defensible with a GPU and a matured dataset

compute_gap.note: Steady-state figures cover weights, gradients, AdamW moments and stored activations; they exclude tokenizer buffers and the OS. 'fits_available_ram' is the binding test on a shared machine: this host reports only a fraction of a GiB free, so even proposals that fit installed RAM cannot start while other work is running. Any scale beyond the largest fitting proposal needs hardware this host does not have.

validation_gates: G1 data: each target task has licence-verified supervision with an isolated holdout that shares no repository or content hash
G2 preflight: training.preflight passes with a measured probe, not an estimate, on the actual training host
G3 evaluation: a frozen benchmark exists BEFORE training starts and covers the tasks being claimed
G4 capability: functional pass rate rises above the M3/M4 baseline on a benchmark large enough to be non-anecdotal
G5 regression: general-code behaviour does not degrade

recommended_next_experiment.rationale: It is the largest configuration already authored and preflight-measured on this host, so it isolates the data question from the compute question. Scaling the model before fixing the data would repeat the M4 error of adding capacity without adding supervision.
preconditions: licence-verified instruction data for at least code_generation, debugging and unit_test_generation
a frozen benchmark covering those tasks, versioned separately from the M5 benchmark
preflight re-run on the exact training host
out_of_scope: any scale above the largest host-fitting proposal
instruction tuning before pretraining data exists
reusing the M4 synthetic instruction construction unchanged

authorisation_required: explicit human authorisation to start a training run
confirmation that new data has passed the licence gate
confirmation that a frozen benchmark predates the run
